summary: Reprogramming (Self-Hypnosis) feature — first testing pass. Backend fully verified: 10/10 pytest tests pass (public + admin sessions listing, session detail 200/404, base64 audio for deep-sleep and confidence with cache verification, MP3 stream with Content-Length, and premium paywall gating for a freshly-registered free user). ElevenLabs synthesis for premium sessions was intentionally NOT triggered (quota-safe). Frontend UI testing is BLOCKED by a pre-existing crash in components/CompanionBubble.tsx at line 272 (`transform: [...bubblePosition.transform, { scale: pulseAnim }]`) — pan.getLayout() on React-Native-Web returns `{left, top}` with no `.transform` array, throwing 'bubblePosition.transform is not iterable'. This crashes RootLayout for every authenticated route on web (including /reprogramming) and even a fresh signup flow lands on the Terms modal before ever seeing the grid. Backend paywall correctness confirmed via curl-level tests, but end-to-end UI journey (list → picker → player → end) could NOT be visually verified on web due to the CompanionBubble crash. React Native issues detected: CompanionBubble transform iteration crash.

minor.issue: get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header — when a test/browser shares a cookie jar between admin and free-user requests, the admin cookie bypasses the paywall and unintentionally triggered ElevenLabs synthesis of quit-smoking during first pytest run (cached now, quota consumed once). Not a production bug (real users don't share sessions), but consider preferring Authorization header when both are present, or documenting this.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKING: `[...bubblePosition.transform, { scale: pulseAnim }]` at line 272 throws 'bubblePosition.transform is not iterable' on web because `Animated.ValueXY.getLayout()` returns only `{left, top}` (no transform array). Crashes RootLayout for every authenticated screen on RN-Web including /reprogramming — page renders blank after error boundary. Fix: use `pan.getTranslateTransform()` (which returns `{transform: [{translateX},{translateY}]}`) instead of `pan.getLayout()`, and drop `bubblePosition` from the style spread; OR guard with `Platform.OS === 'web' ? [] : bubblePosition.transform`.

Recommend a manual/native re-test on Expo Go once CompanionBubble is patched.

rca_of_issue: CompanionBubble uses `pan.getLayout()` (returns {left,top}) but then spreads `bubblePosition.transform` which is undefined on RN-Web → 'is not iterable' TypeError → RootLayout error boundary catches → blank authenticated screens across the app. Native mobile behaves differently (getLayout may include transform on some RN versions), which is why this reached the branch. Fix: use `pan.getTranslateTransform()` OR `[...(bubblePosition.transform || []), { scale: pulseAnim }]` as a minimal defensive patch.
